all.altText: Screenshot of a 3D isometric real-time strategy game in progress. HUD at top reads "1:49", "4×", "Ironclad · Industry" (blue dot), "Boom · Industry" (red dot), resource icons and "0:56", with a blue-versus-red balance bar labeled "B" and "R". A banner in the center top reads "DOUBLE KILL" with "Blue" beneath it. The grassy battlefield shows a blue team base in the lower left with a domed command center, a radar dish, two factory buildings and a turret, plus a refinery labeled "+200" where blue supply trucks carrying crates gather around ore deposits, with floating "+45" labels by the trucks. A gravel road runs diagonally from the base to the upper right, where blue tanks fire a laser at a white enemy unit. Near the base, red enemy tanks under fire show a "+45" label, while blue turrets shoot at them. Rocky outcrops sit at the top left and right center, clusters of low-poly trees line the right and bottom edges, and a minimap is in the top right corner. Pause and mute buttons are at the

Screenshot of the same strategy game, now on a snowy winter map in replay mode. HUD at top reads "6:27", "1×", "anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 · industry" (blue dot), "gpt-6-luna · industry" (red dot), resource icons and "0:03", with the balance bar labeled "B" and "R". A note at top left reads "Blue: Pushing turrets at the enemy's south-east edge." A replay panel below the HUD reads "Blue anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 · industry vs Red gpt-6-luna · industry · frostbite seed 42" with a scrubber at "6:27 / 7:48" and buttons "−30s", "+30s", "All", "Blue's eyes", "Red's eyes" and "Notes". A frozen lake of cracked ice plates fills the left side. In the lower center a group of blue tanks advances past a snow-covered pine forest toward a line of red turrets along the lake shore, one of them burning. A dark rocky ridge crosses the middle, and the red base with a refinery, other buildings, tanks and supply trucks sits in the upper right. Minimap at top right, zoom and lightning buttons at bottom left

thread.text:
In addition to human-vs-in-game-AI and human-vs-human it supports two LLMs playing against each other! That works by pausing the game every 5s for them to think about the game state and queue up commands

Here's a replay link for Haiku 5.5 vs GPT-6 Luna: https://simonw.github.io/battledrones/v11/?replay=battles/showcase/2026-10-14-frostbite-42-claude-haiku-5.5-vs-gpt-6-luna.json
